title: Case — Microsoft Partner Marketing Center Pro

text.content: Large ecosystem where many independent partners need to execute localized campaigns around a shared vendor portfolio.

text.content: Microsoft's Partner Marketing Center Pro centralizes campaign planning, publishing and performance tracking and adds AI-assisted customization, co-branding, localization, automatic sends and reporting. Business Central partner resources also include ready-to-use campaigns, pitch decks, customer stories and a go-to-market journey.
